name: Delegat Group Limited
summary: Delegat Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, and sale of wine. The company markets and sells its products primarily under the Oyster Bay, Barossa Valley Estate, and Delegat brands to retailers and distributors in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Europe, North America, Australia, New Zealand, and the Asia Pacific. It is also involved in brand marketing and investment holding activities. The company was formerly known as Delegat's Group Limited and changed its name to Delegat Group Limited in July 2014.
